item.summary: docs(install): surface desktop app download links for normal-app installs (#127991) * docs(install): surface desktop app download links for users who want a normal app install (#126694) * docs(install): clarify both desktop apps provision gateways Keep the contributor desktop-download instructions accurate for both Windows Hub and the macOS app: each can provision a local Gateway during first-run setup or connect to an existing remote Gateway.
